name: Statutory lien waiver reconciled against its AIA G702 pay application and the payment record (CA Civ. Code 8132-8138, TX Prop. Code 53.284). DEMO, synthetic fixtures only: not a benchmark.

sources.CA-8132: Cal. Civ. Code 8132 (Conditional Waiver and Release on Progress Payment), https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=8132 (raw: sources/ca-civ-8132.raw.html)
sources.CA-8134: Cal. Civ. Code 8134 (Unconditional Waiver and Release on Progress Payment), https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=8134 (raw: sources/ca-civ-8134.raw.html)
sources.CA-8136: Cal. Civ. Code 8136 (Conditional Waiver and Release on Final Payment), https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=8136 (raw: sources/ca-civ-8136.raw.html)
sources.CA-8138: Cal. Civ. Code 8138 (Unconditional Waiver and Release on Final Payment), https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=8138 (raw: sources/ca-civ-8138.raw.html)
sources.TX-53.284: Tex. Prop. Code 53.284(b)-(e) (the four waiver and release forms), https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/PR/htm/PR.53.htm#53.284 (raw: sources/tx-prop-ch53.raw.htm, fetched from https://tcss.legis.texas.gov/resources/PR/htm/PR.53.htm)
sources.G702: AIA G702 line 8 'current payment due' and the application number, as the built-in verify ruleset pay-app@0.0.1 binds them (products/verify/src/rulesets/pay-app). 'Period To' is the G702 header field; it is not sourced from AIA text in this demo (the AIA form is licensed).

checks.name: The waiver is on the statutory form of the state where the property sits [CA-8132..CA-8138, TX-53.284]

fail.detail: The waiver is on the {op:FORM_STATE} statutory form but the property is in {op:PAYAPP_PROJECT_STATE}: obtain a waiver on the {op:PAYAPP_PROJECT_STATE} statutory form.
If the form's state was misread, re-read waiver.form.state from the form's title and statute and run the check again.

checks.name: Progress vs final: the waiver's form type matches whether the pay application is final [CA-8132..CA-8138, TX-53.284]

fail.detail: The waiver's form is final={asserted} (1 = a final-payment form) but the pay application is final={expected}: obtain the waiver form that matches the payment (progress for a progress application, final for the final application).

checks.name: An unconditional waiver is given only after the payment has cleared (FORM_UNCONDITIONAL <= PAYMENT_CLEARED) [CA-8134, CA-8138, TX-53.284]

fail.detail: The waiver is unconditional but the payment record does not show the payment cleared: supply evidence that the payment cleared the bank.
Or replace it with the conditional form until the payment clears (the statutory unconditional notice: 'IF YOU HAVE NOT BEEN PAID, USE A CONDITIONAL WAIVER AND RELEASE FORM').

checks.name: The waiver's Through Date equals the pay application's period-to (Through Date is a blank on CA 8132/8134 progress forms only) [CA-8132, CA-8134, G702]

fail.detail: The waiver's Through Date ({asserted}) is not the pay application's period-to ({expected}): obtain a waiver through {expected}, or re-read the Through Date.

abstain.detail: No Through Date was read. CA 8132/8134 progress forms carry one: supply it. CA 8136/8138 final forms and the TX 53.284 forms have no Through Date blank, so on those forms this check does not apply.

checks.name: A TX progress waiver covers 'the attached statement(s) or progress payment request(s)': the attached request is this pay application [TX-53.284]

fail.detail: The waiver's attached payment request is No. {asserted} but this pay application is No. {expected}: obtain a waiver with this application attached, or re-read the attachment.

abstain.detail: No attached payment request was read. TX 53.284(b)/(c) progress forms cover the attached request: supply its number. CA forms and TX final forms do not, so on those forms this check does not apply.

checks.name: The waiver amount equals the pay application's current payment due, G702 line 8 (CA/TX unconditional FINAL forms state no amount: 'paid in full') [CA-8132, CA-8134, CA-8136, TX-53.284, G702]

fail.detail: The waiver states {asserted}; the pay application's current payment due (G702 line 8) is {expected}; difference {variance}. If the difference equals retainage, the waiver counted retainage the payer holds back. Obtain a waiver for {expected}, or re-read the amount.

abstain.detail: No waiver amount was read. Every form except the unconditional final forms (CA 8138, TX 53.284(e): 'paid in full') has an amount blank: supply it.

checks.name: The payment record's amount equals the pay application's current payment due (G702 line 8) [G702]

fail.detail: The payment is {asserted} but the pay application's current payment due is {expected} (difference {variance}): supply the payment record for the full amount, or the change order / certificate that reduced it.
A short payment of {variance} is a payer decision: the approver rules, for this verdict only.

checks.name: The payment is payable to the claimant (check payable to) [CA-8132, CA-8136, TX-53.284]

fail.detail: The payment is payable to {asserted} but the waiver's claimant is {expected}: the waiver and the payment must name the same party.

checks.name: The waiver's claimant (CA 'Name of Claimant'; TX signer's 'Company name') is the pay application's contractor [CA-8132..CA-8138, TX-53.284, G702]

fail.detail: The waiver is signed for {asserted} but the pay application is from {expected}: obtain the waiver from {expected}, or re-read the claimant.

checks.name: The waiver's customer (CA 'Name of Customer'; TX 'person with whom signer contracted') is the pay application's owner, for a prime contractor's waiver [CA-8132..CA-8138, TX-53.284]

fail.detail: The waiver names {asserted} as the customer but the pay application's owner is {expected}: re-read it; a subcontractor's waiver (customer = the prime) is outside this demo.

checks.name: The waiver's Owner is the pay application's owner [CA-8132..CA-8138, TX-53.284, G702]

fail.detail: The waiver names owner {asserted} but the pay application's owner is {expected}: obtain a corrected waiver, or re-read the owner.

checks.name: The waiver's property (CA 'Job Location'; TX 'located at') is the pay application's project address [CA-8132..CA-8138, TX-53.284, G702]

fail.detail: The waiver releases rights at {asserted} but the pay application is for {expected}: obtain a waiver for this property.

checks.name: Exceptions are empty or itemized: the unpaid-progress-payment amount stated in the CA 8132 exception (3) equals the sum of its itemized amounts, else zero when nothing is itemized [CA-8132]

fail.detail: The exceptions state {asserted} of unpaid progress payments but the itemized amounts total {expected}: itemize each earlier conditional waiver (its date and its unpaid amount).

checks.name: Each itemized exception names the date of the earlier conditional waiver it excepts and a positive amount [CA-8132]
checks.guard_reason: CA 8132 exception (3) pairs 'Date(s) of waiver and release' with 'Amount(s) of unpaid progress payment(s)'

fail.detail: Itemized exception {line} states {asserted}, not a positive amount: re-read it.

abstain.detail: Itemized exception {line} has an amount but no date of the earlier waiver: supply the date, or the exception is not itemized.
